latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of mcporter, a CLI tool for interacting with 50+ AI models and utilities.

- Use the mcporter CLI to list, configure, authenticate, and call MCP servers and tools.
- Access over 50 models for tasks including image/video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, search, document processing, email, and SMS.
- Unified API supports multiple providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Minimax, etc).
- Offers smart routing to automatically select the best or most cost-effective model for any task.
- Includes example cURL commands and parameter documentation for each supported capability.
